summary: 9F Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of an entrustment transaction with SCLOUDPAY (HONGKONG) INTERNATIONAL LIMITED. 9F purchased loan receivables for HKD 101 million on behalf of the Principal and then transferred them. The Principal will pay in installments by November 30, 2026, with 8% annual funding expenses, secured by pledge and custody arrangements. The transaction is not a special situation under typical categories, as it is a routine asset purchase and entrustment arrangement. Observe installment payments and safeguard provisions for risk assessment.
